step:p1:coh-real.why: g real on R^n implies cohSolution real on R^n (conjugate-symmetric coefficients).

step:p3:torsion-bound-step.ref: KAM.Uniq.torsion_bound (third conjunct, KAM/Uniq/Frame.lean:313) with local facts hdir' (Cauchy, delta=rho/4, via KAM.cauchy_corollaries_directional_real) and hX in its proof
step:p3:torsion-bound-step.why: T bound on T_{3rho/4} by C_tor is exported; the intermediate bounds ||d_omega N||<=4 n Gamma sigma_K sigma_B/rho and ||X_N||<=sigma_K sigma_B M(1+4 n C_P/rho) are proved inline (hdir', hX), no step-level audit row.

bp:p4:SA.why: Definitions only: SA = 0<gamma<=1, 0<=eps<=c_* gamma^4; eta0 = A0 eps/gamma^2; OmegaGamma = frequencyMap h "" B intersect Dio; audit PASS (exact formulas).

bp:p4:normalized-torus.why: Literal constructions K_omega=(K^inf)^[-ph], W_omega=K_omega-K0_omega (K^inf chosen by Classical.epsilon of the APPLY clauses); no existence theorem is part of this definition node, audited PASS as prescribed constructions.

step:p4:hq-trivial.why: Empty B gives eps_0=1; otherwise 0<vol B<inf and vol F_B = vol B; empty/positivity cases are inline in headq_of_head.

step:p4:hq-approx.why: dyadic_approx gives open B subset B with vol(B minus B)<=eta and a boundary-layer constant; headq_of_head applies it with eta = kappa vol(B)/2.

step:p4:hq-head.why: HEAD hypotheses (incl. nondegeneracy on closure) transferred to B-prime; eps_0 is exactly the blueprint minimum.

step:p4:hq-transfer.why: Perturbation hypotheses restricted to B-prime, eps>=0 from the nonempty original B, and C eps^{1/4}<=kappa vol(B)/2.

step:p4:hq-cover.why: Measure of F_B minus kamCover_B(kappa) <= vol F_(B minus B-prime) + vol(F_B-prime minus cover) <= kappa vol B = kappa vol F_B.
